Is there anything else a beginner needs to get started?
A
Message from Alen Customer Experience Team:
To get started with an Alen air purifier, here’s what you’ll typically need to do: 
Take your Alen out of the box and remove all protective films.
Note: Your filter is already inside your unit, so you'll need to open your front panel to unwrap your filter!
Find a good spot for your purifier.
We recommend placing your Alen along your room's longest wall, at least 18 inches away from furniture.
Plug in your Alen and press the button to turn it on. Leave your Alen running 24/7 for best results!
